  "clothing_decisions": {
    "character": "Inaria",

    "outfit": {
      "top": "Lightweight, opaque, fitted short-sleeve blouse in a restrained neutral or established Inaria palette.",
      "bottom": "High-waisted, knee-length tailored shorts or a simple knee-length skirt with practical coverage and believable construction.",
      "footwear": "Simple low-profile summer shoes or secure-strap sandals with anatomically plausible foot placement.",
      "accessories": "Minimal or omitted accessories; use only items already consistent with Inaria's established design.",
      "materials": "Breathable cotton, linen, or similarly stable fabrics with simple folds and low visual complexity.",
      "fit": "Comfortable, non-distorting fit that preserves Inaria's canonical body silhouette and supports reliable generation."
    },
    "styling": "Coordinate the neckline, sleeve length, and accessory clearance with the established hairstyle without altering the canonical hair identity.",
    "construction": "Use clean seams, plausible closures, consistent hems, and simple garment intersections; avoid excessive layering, ties, straps, or complex patterns.",
    "pose_compatibility": "Designed for a neutral standing or relaxed walking pose with stable anatomy and unobstructed hands, feet, face, and hair.",
    "unresolved_conflicts": []
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Preserve the established Inaria identity exactly.",
    "Do not alter canonical facial features, hair identity, skin tone, age, body proportions, or recognizable silhouette.",
    "Clothing must not change perceived age, gender presentation, body structure, or character identity.",
    "Prioritize believable anatomy, proportional hands and feet, clean clothing intersections, and generation reliability.",
    "Do not introduce permanent design elements through temporary clothing, accessories, color, pose, lighting, or scene.",
    "Maintain consistent character versioning across outputs."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Vary blouse and bottom colors within the established Inaria palette.",
    "Alternate between tailored knee-length shorts and a simple knee-length skirt when appropriate.",
    "Vary breathable fabric texture, minor folds, and understated summer styling.",
    "Omit or vary noncanonical accessories to support dataset diversity.",
    "Vary neutral summer poses, framing, lighting, and backgrounds without changing identity."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Identity constraints take priority over clothing styling.",
    "Keep the outfit opaque, practical, seasonally appropriate, and visually simple.",
    "Avoid logos, prominent patterns, excessive jewelry, unstable layered details, and identity-defining accessories.",
    "If canonical reference details conflict with clothing choices, retain the canonical identity and adapt the outfit."
  ]
}
